card.name: Start of omit and emesis words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a split word where the next piece completes 'omit' or 'emesis' (or 'emulsion'), such as 'O' before 'mit dose' or 'em' before 'esis'. It appears in dosing tables and overdose text.

modes.label: Emesis split
modes.description: The piece 'em' that begins vomiting terms like emesis, in overdose or side-effect text.

modes.label: Omit split
modes.description: A capital 'O' that starts 'Omit dose' in dose-adjustment tables.
